symbol_meanings.unicast_send_available: The messaging service offers an operation for sending a unicast message to a specified address.
symbol_meanings.unicast_received: The selected unicast message is received in the selected symbolic occurrence.
symbol_meanings.receiving_address: Opaque identity of the receiving address for that same selected message; only equality has meaning.
symbol_meanings.specified_address: Opaque identity of that selected message's specified destination address; only equality has meaning.
symbol_meanings.ttl_configuration_available: The messaging service offers an operation for configuring multicast message TTL, defined as hop count.
